purpose: Trace all 24 question intents from provider/internal inputs through append-only journal families and Rust projections to bounded shared API/MCP queries and required tests.
scope_note: Logical required contract, not database migrations, executable tests or live integration evidence. Supplemental inputs must actually be collected; generic API/replay availability does not imply merchant coverage.

common_test_fixture_context.rule: Unless a case overrides it, synthesize all required datasets with complete scoped coverage, valid identity/evidence links and the same committed/applied cutoff. Unmentioned balances are zero only within this explicit synthetic fixture. Adapt canonical assertions through the real ingestion pipeline; these snippets are not provider payloads.

first_release_assessment_definitions.documented_provider_path: Candidate API objects/endpoints are documented. Integration, actual account coverage and end-to-end correctness remain unverified; business rules/links/coverage still apply.
first_release_assessment_definitions.supplemental_data_required: At least one indispensable input needs an explicit merchant rule, typed feed, reviewed observation or verified derivation beyond merely connecting the launch providers.
first_release_assessment_definitions.provider_detail_unverified: One or more crucial detail/relationship semantics have not been established from the reviewed launch-provider schema; use a verified supplemental source or return partial/unknown.
first_release_assessment_definitions.bank_import_required: Independent booked bank records must be imported; no live bank connector or automatic bank confirmation is implied.

providers.name: Shopify
providers.ingestion: GraphQL Admin API: paginated backfill and reconciliation; verified HTTPS webhooks trigger durable receipt and re-fetch. Pin an API version and fixture schema; consume all nested pages.
providers.external_prerequisites: read_orders; older order access needs read_all_orders approval. read_inventory and appropriate fulfillment-order scopes; read_returns for return objects. Prove actual grants and protected customer-data access. Record history start and every missing scope.

field_mappings.note: Version line quantities, prices, discounts, shipping and taxes. Current totals are not the original agreed amount; preserve revisions. Custom/non-product lines need explicit identity, not a fabricated SKU.

These fields have different quantity/discount bases. Compare compatible versions and currencies; do not approximate line totals by multiplying rounded unit prices. Map shipping and order-level adjustments explicitly in the adapter contract.

Read named on_hand/available/committed/reserved/damaged/safety_stock/quality_control/incoming states. available is already net of unavailable states. Do not subtract reservations from it again; incoming is not on-hand.
Location assignment and outstanding work do not prove a physical stock reservation. Import explicit reservation evidence or publish a versioned derived allocation with a policy and coverage check.
Distinguish created, handed over, delivered and cancelled. A tracking label alone does not establish goods movement.
Successful sale/capture, authorization, failure, void and refund have different effects. Shopify and provider views of the same payment must share one economic identity.

Requested/closed return is not proof of warehouse receipt. Inspect disposition semantics and merchant practice; MISSING is not received and RESTOCKED is not a second physical receipt. Refund object alone does not establish successful cash movement.

providers.name: Shopify Payments
providers.ingestion: Query ShopifyPaymentsAccount balanceTransactions, payouts and disputes with pagination; reconcile provider balances independently of order ingestion.
providers.external_prerequisites: An eligible Shopify Payments account and actual finance/dispute grants. Account docs list read_shopify_payments or read_shopify_payments_accounts; payout objects require view_payouts permission and disputes require read_shopify_payments_disputes. Validate all field-level access in the pinned schema/account.

field_mappings.note: Optional links can be absent. Reconcile each payout membership and sign convention; do not guess allocation from equal amounts.
Provider payout state is a provider assertion, not independent bank evidence. Track failed/reversed transfers separately.
Detailed processing/available/held amounts, hold reasons and release promises are not established by this balance field. Keep unsupported breakdowns unknown until a verified source/report is mapped.
Need separate booked debit/reversal evidence and a proven original-transaction link. An open dispute is not a final repayment; order-level linkage can be ambiguous with multiple captures.

providers.name: easybill
providers.ingestion: GET /documents and /documents/{id}; /document-payments; /post-boxes; document versions where available. Reconcile edited_at with overlap and stable page handling. Webhook notifications can trigger authenticated re-fetch; verify the documented signature scheme before trusting payloads.
providers.external_prerequisites: Authorized account/API credential and actual plan limits. Schema reviewed: REST v1, info.version 1.103.1, SHA256 6d532f96a7fe82fcbd556178f8bd2a11f364061690f67ccb932d3722ac2b1e86. Verify signs, correction linkage, historical version completeness and account-specific field population in fixtures and an authorized account.

field_mappings.note: Document.status is not an invoice-paid status. Order references need a connection-specific namespace and validated association. Credit/STORNO signs and chains must be tested.
A marker is evidence of the invoice tool report, not an additional cash movement; reconcile to actual payments when linked.
OK is provider-reported processing/sending evidence, not proof the recipient read or received the message. Missing postbox data is not proof of non-sending.

providers.name: DHL Unified Tracking
providers.ingestion: GET https://api-eu.dhl.com/track/shipments?trackingNumber=... for known shop shipment references; optional authorized push subscriptions with reconciliation. Back off and stop/slow polling terminal shipments according to the actual contract.
providers.external_prerequisites: Eligible tracking numbers, API subscription key, product coverage and quotas. Published Unified Tracking terms include deletion 30 days after delivery unless otherwise agreed. Resolve retention and permitted downstream use before live append-only ingestion; raw-data separation alone does not establish rights to retain derived tracking facts indefinitely.

field_mappings.note: Bind to an explicit shop shipment/line mapping; carrier scans do not contain authoritative SKU quantities. Preserve raw codes and timezone; service-specific fields and forecast/history coverage vary.

providers.name: Validated bank statement CSV
providers.ingestion: Authorized upload -> versioned mapping/validation -> durable import records -> same journal/outbox/engine path.
providers.external_prerequisites: A statement supplied by the merchant, explicit account/currency/date/sign mapping and declared coverage interval. No live bank API is included.

field_mappings.note: Require booked status and unique matching evidence; equal amounts alone are ambiguous. Corrections append. Partial statement coverage cannot prove non-arrival.

providers.name: Signed typed business-event API
providers.ingestion: Versioned authenticated event envelope with idempotency key, tenant-bound connection, source identity, occurred_at and typed payload.
providers.external_prerequisites: Must be implemented and actually supplied by an authorized merchant system/operator. A defined schema does not collect data by itself.

field_mappings.note: Synthetic replay and production feed must use this same validated persistence path; never silently mix sample events with real tenant answers.

providers.name: Deterministic synthetic replay
providers.ingestion: Replay typed observations through the same tenant-scoped ingestion path.
providers.external_prerequisites: Clearly synthetic isolated workspace; no provider access claimed.

providers.name: Versioned workspace rules
providers.ingestion: Authorized settings/import appends rule-change evidence; runtime query reads the version effective at its cutoff.
providers.external_prerequisites: Owner-supplied allocation, invoicing, delivery-risk and reminder policy; no undocumented defaults that decide business obligations.

questions.question: Can I still sell 100 Olive Cups?
questions.blocking_data_gap: Validate inventory state basis and scope; optional incoming supply is separately unknown if absent.
questions.query_rule: Use authoritative available state OR derive from disjoint physical/unavailable states at one cutoff. Show requested quantity, free amount and shortfall; incoming supply never fills current stock.
questions.access_path: Item/location direct lookup, bounded location aggregation with explicit unit; no event scan.

additional_cases: Provider available=86 must not become 52 after subtracting 34 again.
Multi-location and quarantined stock; untracked/bundled items.

questions.question: Which open orders can be fulfilled entirely from available stock?
questions.blocking_data_gap: Explicit reservations or declared derived allocation and merchant priority policy.
questions.query_rule: Build a non-mutating fulfillment plan at a fixed snapshot. Respect existing allocations and eligibility, then allocate free stock once across the bounded candidate set in declared priority order. Distinguish tentative plan from committed stock.
questions.access_path: Open-order/item indexes; bounded plan or asynchronous job for large populations, stable result cursor.

additional_cases: Never use the same ten units for both orders.
Existing reservation belonging to this order is not unavailable to itself.

questions.question: Which orders have a mismatch between promised and reserved quantities?
questions.blocking_data_gap: Line-level reservation ownership cannot be inferred from an aggregate stock number.
questions.query_rule: For each line calculate remaining accepted obligation after explicit cancellations and confirmed dispatch, then compare active assigned reservation at the same cutoff. Avoid subtracting cancelled amounts twice from already-current quantities.
questions.access_path: Open-line and allocation adjacency indexes.

additional_cases: Over-reservation; line edits; release without shipment.

questions.question: Which open orders are affected by a delayed incoming delivery?
questions.blocking_data_gap: Supplier/PO promise revisions and supply-to-order dependencies require a supplemental feed.
questions.query_rule: Follow the changed incoming promise through explicit allocations to customer lines; compare revised receipt with customer deadline and show dependency gaps.
questions.access_path: Promise-to-item-to-allocated-order indexes, bounded dependent-order page.

additional_cases: Shared SKU without allocation is potential exposure, not proven dependency.

questions.question: Where are my parcels, and which need attention?
questions.blocking_data_gap: DHL entitlement/retention and exact shop shipment link; merchant stale-scan threshold is configurable.
questions.query_rule: Return latest supported scan and forecast with age, mapped exception and explicit attention policy. A forecast is not a promise and stale data is not a delivery failure.
questions.access_path: Status/last-scan indexes and shipment-by-order lookup.

additional_cases: Label-only; late scan; tracking number reused by carrier/service.

questions.question: Which customer delivery commitments are overdue or at risk?
questions.blocking_data_gap: Explicit customer deadline and timezone; carrier ETA is not that promise.
questions.query_rule: Compare current customer commitment against confirmed delivered status and configured risk rule, using timezone-aware deadlines.
questions.access_path: Open-promise due index joined to shipment state by order.

additional_cases: Newer reviewed promise supersedes old deadline; incomplete carrier coverage.

questions.question: Which partial deliveries still have missing items?
questions.blocking_data_gap: Per-line shipment association and handover/delivery evidence; packing gaps remain explicit.
questions.query_rule: Separately report remaining_to_dispatch and remaining_to_deliver for non-cancelled line quantities. Do not conflate handover and delivery or count a shipping label as either.
questions.access_path: Order/line-to-shipment adjacency; bounded partial-shipment groups.

additional_cases: Multiple packages; delivered carrier scan without package-to-line mapping.

questions.question: What can I reliably tell this customer about their delivery status?
questions.blocking_data_gap: Prior communication needs a reviewed feed or later mailbox/helpdesk integration.
questions.query_rule: Produce structured reply facts with evidence and known promises; external LLM may phrase them. If communication is missing, supply only the evidenced shipment fragment and flag omitted context. Never send automatically.
questions.access_path: Customer/order identity lookup plus bounded shipment/communication locators.

given.prior_message: We will update you after the next scan.

additional_cases: Wrong customer authorization; unknown ETA; no invented apology or promise.

questions.question: Which invoices are still outstanding?
questions.blocking_data_gap: Correction chain, payment markers and invoice/order links must be validated per account.
questions.query_rule: Calculate the latest reported receivable from original finalized invoice and unique correction/payment effects; expose reported versus independently reconciled amounts. Negative balances are credit/overpayment, not negative debt.
questions.access_path: Open receivable index by due date/customer/currency.

additional_cases: Draft invoices; STORNO of a credit; payment-marker deletion appended as correction.

questions.question: Which orders still need an invoice under our invoicing rule?
questions.blocking_data_gap: Merchant invoicing trigger plus complete invoice population and confirmed cross-system links.
questions.query_rule: Select orders satisfying the rule; check linked valid invoice quantities/amounts including partial invoices. Absence only means missing when population coverage and identity are complete.
questions.access_path: Rule-eligible order index with order-to-document anti-join bounded by cutoff.

additional_cases: Partial billing; old orders outside import window; cancelled invoices.

questions.question: Where does the invoice amount differ from the agreed order amount?
questions.blocking_data_gap: Version-aligned line equivalence and currency basis; unmatched shipping/tax/discount allocation stays unresolved.
questions.query_rule: Compare documented agreed order version and linked invoice coverage using exact decimal/tax/discount rules. Partial invoices compare only the covered lines/quantities; no currency conversion without an explicit rate.
questions.access_path: Order-to-invoice-line adjacency; bounded line reconciliation.

additional_cases: Partial invoice is not a shortfall; original agreement unavailable after backfill.

questions.question: Which invoices were created but have no evidence of being sent?
questions.blocking_data_gap: easybill postbox coverage must include external-send limitations; sending is not receipt.
questions.query_rule: For finalized invoices expose provider-reported send evidence, pending/error, or no evidence within a declared scope. Do not claim definitely unsent from absence.
questions.access_path: Finalized-document index and document-to-dispatch lookup.

additional_cases: External send; postbox ERROR; sent event replay.

questions.question: Which orders are only authorized, actually paid or still awaiting payment?
questions.blocking_data_gap: Successful transaction amounts and gateway/account identity, not just order financial labels.
questions.query_rule: Compare confirmed captured amount to the current obligation. Report authorization, capture, void, failures, partial collections and remaining balance separately.
questions.access_path: Order-to-transaction adjacency and unresolved-payment index.

additional_cases: Authorization expires; two partial captures; failed capture not paid.

questions.question: Which failed payments have since been completed successfully?
questions.blocking_data_gap: Complete attempt history and same-order identity; later success can still be only partial.
questions.query_rule: Retain all attempts, compare later confirmed collections with the required amount, separate resolved from still-open deficits.
questions.access_path: Failed-attempt subset and order-to-attempt ordered adjacency.

additional_cases: Same amount on different order; successful authorization without capture.

questions.question: Which invoices have a mismatch between partial payments and the remaining amount?
questions.blocking_data_gap: Proven invoice-to-payment allocation; multiple invoices and manual payments need explicit association.
questions.query_rule: Reconcile gross allocated customer payments and credits to the receivable. Report unallocated money separately. Provider fees never reduce the customer payment.
questions.access_path: Invoice-to-payment-allocation adjacency; unresolved residual index.

additional_cases: Overpayment; cash/manual transfer; duplicate invoice-tool marker.

questions.question: Which due receivables should Finance review today?
questions.blocking_data_gap: Reminder policy, investigations and agreed extensions require explicit business context.
questions.query_rule: Prioritize due net receivables under the rule; show holds/extensions and payment uncertainty. Output a review queue, not automatic dunning.
questions.access_path: Due-date/currency index joined to current case flags; bounded ordered page.

additional_cases: Paid after due date; extension; active dispute; zero or credit balance.

questions.question: Where is my money across payment providers?
questions.blocking_data_gap: Detailed held/processing/available breakdown and independent bank coverage are not implied by the default finance API.
questions.query_rule: Reconcile current account/currency positions with ledger and statement evidence. The categories must be disjoint; report unknown components and residuals rather than inventing zeros. Preserve opening balances and non-sale adjustments.
questions.access_path: Account/currency rollups plus payout matching indexes; no full historical scan.

additional_cases: Multiple currencies; reserve release; transfer reversal; incomplete opening ledger.

questions.question: Why is the payout lower than captured customer payments?
questions.blocking_data_gap: Complete payout member postings and signed adjustments; do not explain using all payments in a date window.
questions.query_rule: Sum only the postings assigned to this payout, separating captures/fees/refunds/other adjustments. Compare result to payout amount; retain any residual.
questions.access_path: Payout-to-ledger-entry adjacency with incremental per-payout totals; paginated explanation.

additional_cases: FX/withdrawal adjustments; negative payout; missing source transaction link.

questions.question: Which announced or sent payouts still lack bank evidence?
questions.blocking_data_gap: A real validated bank-statement import is required; provider payout status alone is insufficient.
questions.query_rule: Match uniquely evidenced booked bank entries to sent payouts by account/reference/currency/amount with explicit tolerances. Report pending, unmatched or ambiguous and statement coverage separately.
questions.access_path: Unmatched sent-payout index and indexed bank match candidates; fixed cutoff.

additional_cases: Identical amount for two payouts; bank pending versus booked; split/combined deposit.

questions.question: Which amounts are held, and which releases are only announced?
questions.blocking_data_gap: A verified source for hold identity/reason/amount and release promise is still needed.
questions.query_rule: Read current hold versions; distinguish promised release from actual release, scoped to account/currency. No summing superseded holds.
questions.access_path: Active-hold index by account/currency/release-date; bounded evidence detail.

additional_cases: Partially released hold; changed promise; unrelated dispute amount.

questions.question: Which returns are announced, received or already refunded?
questions.blocking_data_gap: Actual line-level warehouse receipt/disposition and refund links; a return request is only intent.
questions.query_rule: Report independent quantities for requested/received/quarantined/restocked and separate refund money/status. Do not collapse them into one completed flag.
questions.access_path: Open return index and return-to-line/receipt/refund adjacency.

additional_cases: MISSING disposition; delivered parcel with unverified contents; restock without duplicate physical receipt.

questions.question: Which credit notes are missing their corresponding refund?
questions.blocking_data_gap: Explicit refund entitlement, original payment and destination; an unpaid invoice credit may only reduce debt.
questions.query_rule: Compare approved cash refund entitlement with confirmed refunds linked to the same original payment. Credit documents alone do not create a cash repayment.
questions.access_path: Open entitlement index and credit-to-original-payment/refund adjacency.

additional_cases: Unpaid invoice credited: no automatic refund.
Store credit agreed; partial refund; credit reversed.

questions.question: What still needs correcting in stock, invoicing and payment after a cancellation?
questions.blocking_data_gap: Reservation ownership and financial/warehouse reconciliation context must be available, including explicit not-applicable states.
questions.query_rule: Build independent reservation, stock, invoice and payment checks at one cutoff. A cancellation cannot reverse a completed shipment or payment by itself. Branch between unshipped cancellation and return of shipped goods.
questions.access_path: Cancelled-order index and bounded related-entity graph; one snapshot across projections.

additional_cases: Shipment already happened; void authorization instead of refund; already completed correction.

questions.question: Is there a risk of duplicate repayment through both a refund and a chargeback?
questions.blocking_data_gap: Exact original-transaction linkage plus booked chargeback debit/reversal evidence is still unproven for the default adapter.
questions.query_rule: For each original capture compare completed cash refunds and net booked chargeback debits excluding separately identified fees. Flag over-repayment and overlapping pending actions for review; neither an open dispute nor a fee is a completed refund.
questions.access_path: Original-transaction-to-refund/dispute adjacency; index active risk cases.

additional_cases: Open dispute with zero booked debit; won dispute reversal; partial refunds; chargeback fees excluded.

coverage_rule: All 24 must have positive and insufficient-data executable acceptance evidence through committed PostgreSQL ingestion and the Rust query service over API/MCP. A system returning unknown for every question cannot pass. Missing external credentials may block live verification but do not excuse missing synthetic positive paths.

implementation_status_authority.note: This catalogue describes required data and candidate API mappings, not runtime verification. Current source-capability status has one authority in the integration register.
